:::{#def-strict-inequality}
#### Strict and non-strict inequalities

For [real numbers](notation.qmd#def-real-numbers) $a$ and $b$,
$a < b$ ("$a$ is less than $b$")
and $a > b$ ("$a$ is greater than $b$")
are **strict inequalities**.
The **non-strict inequalities** also allow equality:

- $a \le b$ means $a < b$ or $a = b$;
- $a \ge b$ means $a > b$ or $a = b$.

:::
